title: Building a Tanki Online-style LAN game with Claude in a weekend: anyone tried something similar?
author: Few_Ad_5929
selftext:
Hey everyone! A few friends and I are having a LAN party this weekend, and we all love old-school Tanki Online (the 2012-2016 Flash era). Normal progression would take weeks, and we only have \~2 days, so I want to build a simple local “Tanki-like” game with **boosted XP and crystal gains** so we can unlock hulls, turrets and paints fast.

**My plan:**

* Browser-based, host on one PC, others join over LAN
* Node.js + WebSockets (server-authoritative), simple 3D/2.5D tank movement and shooting
* A few turrets and hulls with different stats, a basic garage, and XP/crystal rewards with an adjustable multiplier
* Vibe-coding most of it with Claude

**What I’d love advice on:**

1. Has anyone built a multiplayer arena/tank game with AI tools? How far did you get, and where did the AI struggle (netcode, physics, sync)?
2. Any prompting workflow that worked well for multiplayer games, e.g. building the server first, or one feature at a time?
3. Good lightweight engine/library choices for a quick prototype (Phaser, Three.js, Babylon, Godot web export)?
4. Any tips for keeping scope realistic in 2 days?

I’ll share the result and what worked or didn’t after the weekend. Thanks!
